end.summary:
• Discussed shared responsibility for keeping the school clean, green and safe.
• Practised sorting wet waste into the green bin and dry waste into the blue bin.
• Identified vegetable peels and dry leaves as compostable materials.
• Discussed turning compost to let air reach microbes.
• Plastic was repeatedly mixed up with compostable waste; it was later placed in the dry bin, but the confusion remained.
end.parentNote: Anika practised waste sorting, composting, and ways everyone can help keep school clean and safe. They correctly named vegetable peels and dry leaves for compost and explained that turning lets air reach microbes. Anika mixed up plastic with compostable waste; this was discussed and they later stated that plastic belongs in the dry bin, though the idea should be revisited. At home, ask them to sort a few household items into wet and dry waste and explain why plastic does not go in compost.
